PROCEDURE (OPERATIVE) REPORT - Merrimack Endoscopy Center Date of procedure: 02/15/2060 Page 1 of 2 Patient: EZE, NGOZI (previously HALVORSON, NGOZI) MRN 2290-6178 DOB 5/3/2010 Age 49 Endoscopist: Tomasz Wieliczko, MD Nurse: Hannah Prewitt Anesthesia: MAC, Dr. Lindqvist Referring: Dr. Figueiredo / Dr. Al-Rashidi
Indication: Screening for colon cancer, average risk, first time. Family history unclear (see referral). Pre-procedure diagnosis: screening. Post-procedure diagnosis: one small polyp, otherwise normal colon. Procedure: total colonoscopy to cecum with polypectomy.
Description: Patient identified with two identifiers, name and the date of birth. She gave her name as "Ngozi Eze", the wristband say Halvorsen, we call the registration, corrected. Bowel prep was good (Boston 8). Digital exam normal. Colonoscope introduced to the cecum, appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve seen, and the terminal ileum entered (ilium?? - ileum). Withdrawal time 9 minutes. In sigmoid colon was one sessile polyp 4 mm, removed with cold snare, retrieved. Mild diverticula not seen. Hemorrhoids small internal. No bleeding. Patient tolerated well, no complications.
Specimen: sigmoid polyp, jar 1, label barcode SP-60-0215-0447 printed with HALVORSEN N - relabel. Recommendation: wait pathology; if adenoma repeat in 5-10 years. Resume normal diet. Patient told to bring her mother-in-law's... [sentence cut off] Patient's daughter Ada was in waiting room with the aunt, Ifeoma, who drove her.
